summary.zh: 用上下文管理器管好连接、文件和流
summary.en: Manage connections, files, and streams safely

description.zh: 处理文件句柄、数据库连接和流式响应的打开与释放，保证异常路径也能清理干净。适合需要长时间持有资源、或流式返回大量数据的模块。
description.en: Covers context managers, cleanup paths, and streaming for file handles, connections, and responses, including failure cases. Use it when code holds resources or streams large payloads.
